_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: The weekly usage screenshot (usage-watch) retries in the hour before the weekly reset (60/45/30/15 minutes before; tries after the first success skip) and takes the reset time from the usage API, and a session-start hint appears when a scheduled screenshot was missed, has not run for 8 days, or needs the web fallback signed in again; core rules gain "fine-grained memory with solid indexes"; TECH §11.1 cost tables re-measured
